[N1; targeted group-theoretic check] For a centre-free kernel G, an extension with quotient Q and outer action rho:Q→Out(G) identifies with the pullback Q×_{Out(G)}Aut(G): conjugation gives the map from the extension, its kernel is Z(G)=1, and any pullback pair is reached by adjusting a chosen lift by an element of G. For profinite groups this continuous bijection is an isomorphism. Moreover, a trivial centralizer of the image of a map into H forces Z(H)=1. This checks the centre-free reconstruction mechanism invoked on the sheet; it does not prove the geometric hypotheses or the subsequent corollary.
